signal_ids.description: List of alert ids. Use field `_id` on alert document or `kibana.alert.uuid`. Note: signals are a deprecated term for alerts.

runtime_fields.description: Optional map of field name to runtime field type. For each entry, a runtime field of the specified type is created reading its value from `_source[fieldName]` and included in the query as `runtime_mappings`. Use this to reference fields stored on the alert `_source` that are not part of the Elastic Common Schema (ECS) of the alerts index mapping, for example, custom fields that the rule's source index defined when the alerts were created.
